description: Validates API/UI build performance and Lighthouse budgets through performance-health.

capabilities.label: Surface Resolution
capabilities.description: Scenario resolution, Code Facts surface discovery, UI framework detection, and capture-tier selection.

levels.name: Performance surface unavailable
levels.description: The target scenario cannot be resolved or no performance surface can be classified.
levels.capability_summary: Performance Health cannot classify a measurable target surface.
levels.next_unlock: A resolvable scenario with Code Facts-backed performance axes.

levels.name: Capture tier decided
levels.description: Performance Health can decide the reachable capture tier from Code Facts.
levels.capability_summary: The target performance surface and capture tier are known.

levels.name: Surface resolution clean
levels.description: Performance surface resolution is clean and downstream checks can run from known axes.

capabilities.label: Profiling Infrastructure
capabilities.description: React Tier-1 perf-build instrumentation for component commit attribution.

levels.name: Profiling infra unavailable
levels.description: Tier-1 profiling infrastructure cannot be evaluated.
levels.capability_summary: Component-commit attribution cannot be trusted yet.
levels.next_unlock: A React UI surface where perf-build instrumentation can be inspected.

levels.name: Profiling inspectable
levels.description: React perf-build files can be inspected for profiling instrumentation.
levels.next_unlock: Vite profiling aliases, build:profile script, profiler utility, and React.Profiler boundary.

levels.name: Profiling ready
levels.description: Tier-1 React profiling infrastructure is present or vacuously not applicable.

capabilities.label: Budget Gates
capabilities.description: Synchronous and per-flow performance budget breaches for build time, bundle size, LCP, startup, and component commits.

levels.name: Budget gate unavailable
levels.capability_summary: Budget gating cannot be trusted yet.
levels.next_unlock: Readable performance budgets and latest measurement samples.

levels.name: Budget gate active
levels.description: Performance budgets and measurement samples can be evaluated.
levels.next_unlock: No build, bundle, LCP, startup, component-commit, or per-flow budget breach.

levels.name: Budgets honored
levels.description: Declared performance budgets are honored by the newest gated measurement.

capabilities.label: Runtime Measurement
capabilities.description: Execution-mode producer health, Lighthouse thresholds, and trace-analysis hot spots.

levels.name: Runtime measurement unavailable
levels.description: Runtime performance measurement cannot run or cannot produce usable findings.
levels.next_unlock: Build/Lighthouse/trace producers can execute or read artifacts.

levels.name: Runtime measurement active
levels.description: Runtime performance producers can evaluate execution-mode or trace artifacts.
levels.next_unlock: Successful execution producers, Lighthouse thresholds, and component hot-spot checks.

levels.name: Runtime measured
levels.description: Runtime performance producers and trace analysis report no blocking regressions.
levels.capability_summary: Runtime performance measurement is clean enough for local validation.

capabilities.label: Trend Coverage
capabilities.description: Continuous capture, persisted trend coverage, and visibility when a declared budget axis is measured out of band.

levels.name: Trend coverage unavailable
levels.description: Persisted trend coverage cannot be evaluated.
levels.next_unlock: Persisted performance samples for out-of-band axes.

levels.name: Trend visibility
levels.description: Out-of-band performance axes and trend coverage are visible.

levels.name: Trend covered
levels.description: Persisted trend coverage is present for applicable out-of-band axes.

PERF_BUDGET_BREACH_GO_BUILD.reason: A build-time-budget breach is a real performance regression that requires investigation, not a mechanical fix.

PERF_BUDGET_BREACH_UI_BUILD.reason: A UI-build-budget breach is a real performance regression that requires investigation, not a mechanical fix.

PERF_BUDGET_BREACH_BUNDLE.reason: A bundle-size-budget breach is a real performance regression that requires investigation, not a mechanical fix.

PERF_BUDGET_BREACH_LCP.reason: An LCP-budget breach is a real performance regression that requires investigation, not a mechanical fix.

PERF_BUDGET_BREACH_STARTUP.reason: A startup time-to-healthy budget breach is a real performance regression that requires investigation, not a mechanical fix.

PERF_BUDGET_BREACH_COMPONENT_COMMIT_AVG.reason: A component-commit-average budget breach is a real UI performance regression that requires investigation, not a mechanical fix.

PERF_BUDGET_BREACH_COMPONENT_COMMIT_MAX.reason: A component-commit-max budget breach is a real UI performance regression that requires investigation, not a mechanical fix.

PERF_LIGHTHOUSE_BELOW_ERROR_THRESHOLD.reason: A Lighthouse category scoring below its configured error threshold (in .vrooli/lighthouse.json) is a real UI quality/performance regression that requires investigation, not a mechanical fix. This restores the native test-genie perf phase's Lighthouse gating.

PERF_BUILD_FAILED.reason: A build that fails to compile during execution-mode benchmarking is a hard regression: the scenario cannot ship. This restores the native test-genie perf phase's early-exit-on-broken-build behavior.

PERF_COMPONENT_COMMIT_OVER_BUDGET.reason: A slow component commit hot spot requires product and profiling investigation, not a mechanical edit.

PERF_BUDGET_AXIS_UNGATED.reason: An out-of-band measurement axis is visibility debt; changing capture cadence or synchronous coverage is an operational tradeoff.
